page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: & conjunctionem civitatis cum Transla-vicanis paulò altiùs repetere, ut res cla-riùs elucescat, ordo & tempus monent.
main_text.head: DE CONJUNCTIONE CIVITATIS CUM TRAN-SLAVICANIS.
main_text.p: Fœdus cū Octopagicis.IN Transflavicanis Octopagici, Cis-lavicanis finitimi, primi post Scirin-gios à Kenone Groningâ ejectos, commodo societatis cum civitate animadverso, iisdem conditionibus, quibus Hummerzii, Langowoldii, Fredowoldii in commune fœdus ascripti, eidem quoq; se potestati prætoriæ subjecere, & eadem, quæ indè profluunt commoda civitati tribuerunt, cùm annus flueret à nato Christo M. cccc. xvi: tempusque fœderi dederunt decennium. Deinde finito decennio, cùm utilitatem rei essent experti, metuerentque priora mala ἐςόροις[?] demptis, Idem Fœdus ampliatum.fœdus idem indefinitè, nullo statuto termino prorogarunt, additis etiam ad priores socios Hunesgoniis & Fivelgoniis, sed conventuum loco Ado-

page.notes: The Greek word after "metuerentque priora mala" is uncertain and marked [?]. The second marginal note is placed at the point where it stands beside the line "nullo statuto termino". The catchword "ardiæ" is the second half of "Adoardiæ". Long s is transcribed as s. The scan shows a Google digitisation watermark at the lower right, which is not transcribed.
